title: 胡桃 · 无妄坡幽火幻舞
description: 【胡桃 · 无妄坡幽火幻舞】夜幕笼罩下的无妄坡古树林间，幽蓝色的磷火在空中静静漂浮。胡桃身姿轻盈地侧立在盘虬卧龙的古木枝头，单手掐诀操控着身边可爱的火灵小幽灵（Boo Tao），嘴角挂着神秘莫测又调皮可爱的狡黠微笑——「阴阳有序，命运无常！往生堂第七十七代堂主胡桃，奉陪到底哦～」
action: 侧身轻点枝头，单手结印操控悬浮火灵小幽灵（Boo Tao），嘴角带着狡黠神秘微笑
lighting: 幽蓝鬼火冷光与赤红火灵暖光双色交织
camera: full-body shot, side view, branch and spirit in frame
promptProse: Hu Tao balances sideways on a broad old branch above the mist at Wuwang Hill. One hand forms a small guiding sign toward her round, friendly fire spirit while the other steadies her posture against the trunk. Blue wisps hang between the distant trees; the companion casts a warm red edge across her dark director coat, shorts and blossom-trimmed hat. Her flower-shaped red pupils turn toward the viewer with a secretive grin. Show her supported feet, branch and hovering spirit together, with cool forest depth behind them. No lettering.

title: 胡桃 · 往生堂晨曦清理
description: 【胡桃 · 往生堂晨曦清理】清晨第一缕阳光洒在往生堂古朴的青石庭院里，案几上摊开着古老的阴阳仪式典籍与往来账簿。胡桃坐在青石雕花凳上，侧着脑袋轻嗅手中刚刚折下的清晨红梅花枝，神情少见地柔和宁静——「晨光清朗，梅花正艳。生老病死本是常事，但活着的每一天都要开开心心才对嘛！」
action: 整理好的账簿与线装古籍留在案几上，坐在石凳侧头嗅手中红梅
lighting: 柔和清朗的晨曦金光与庭院青砖冷调
promptProse: A red plum blossom rests just beneath Hu Tao’s nose as she pauses beside the courtyard desk. Seated on a carved stone bench, she holds the small branch in one hand and lets the other relax on her lap. The account ledgers and stitched ritual books she has just arranged remain open on the low table. Morning light passes beneath the Wangsheng courtyard eaves, touching the red ribbon at her collar and her unusually gentle smile. The eye-level view includes the bench, table and flower without asking for readable writing.

title: 胡桃 · 飞檐屋顶夕阳赋诗
description: 【胡桃 · 飞檐屋顶夕阳赋诗】黄昏时分的璃月港，万家灯火如星河般逐渐点亮。胡桃盘腿坐在绯云坡古建飞檐的琉璃瓦屋顶上，双手托着脸颊俯瞰繁华港口与绯红晚霞，摇头晃脑地即兴吟诵着大作打油诗——「大太阳落山红霞飞，小胡桃屋顶看落晖！怎么样？本堂主这首诗是不是极有文采？」
location: 璃月港绯云坡古建飞檐屋顶
action: 盘腿坐在琉璃瓦屋脊上，双手托腮俯瞰万家灯火与绯红夕阳，神情灵动惬意
lighting: 壮丽绚烂的绯红金黄晚霞与城市初升暖灯
camera: full-body shot, high angle, harbor behind the seated figure
promptProse: Cross-legged on a broad tiled ridge above Liyue Harbor, Hu Tao cups both cheeks in her hands with her elbows resting on her knees. Her lips part around an improvised little verse, and the red-tipped twintails stir beside her dark uniform coat. From the slightly elevated view, the curve of the roof leads down toward the first harbor lanterns. Crimson sunset meets their warm glow beyond her small, relaxed figure. Keep both hands, folded legs and the supporting roof visible; convey the playful poetry through her expression, without written verse.

title: 胡桃 · 海灯盛典回眸
description: 【胡桃 · 海灯盛典回眸】海灯节万众欢腾的璃月海港观景平台上，数以万计的璀璨霄灯升入夜空。胡桃换上了华美的春风汉服罗裙，在漫天绚烂烟花绽放的瞬间欢快回眸，广袖轻扬，笑容比夜空中的花火还要灿烂夺目——「海灯节快乐！新的一年，也要记得常来往生堂坐坐哦～」
location: 璃月港海灯节观景平台
action: 身着华丽汉服在璀璨霄灯海中欢快回眸，广袖轻扬，背景漫天烟花绚烂
lighting: 万千金色霄灯泛光与夜空烟花多色炫彩
promptProse: Halfway through a light turn on the Lantern Rite viewing terrace, Hu Tao glances back over her shoulder with a broad, delighted smile. Her crimson-and-black hanfu has butterfly embroidery and flowing sleeves, one sleeve lifting gently with the motion. A jade hairpin and the familiar plum decoration catch alternating light from ascending Xiao Lanterns and a fresh burst of fireworks. The dark harbor remains visible below the luminous sky. Frame her from the knees upward at a modest low angle so the turn, sleeve and festive skyline read as one moment.

title: 胡桃 · 翠竹幽径捉迷藏
description: 【胡桃 · 翠竹幽径捉迷藏】轻策庄青翠葱郁的竹林小径上，斑驳的晨光洒在青石板上。胡桃身穿休闲毛衣与百褶短裙，倚在一根粗壮翠竹后探出半边身子，将食指轻抵唇边做出噤声的手势，狡黠的大眼睛里满是想要吓人一跳的俏皮笑意——「嘘——！不要出声！本堂主这次一定要好好吓七七一跳！」
action: 倚在粗壮翠竹后探出半边身子，食指轻抵唇边做噤声手势，眼神充满恶作剧笑意
lighting: 竹叶缝隙漏下的斑驳明亮阳光
promptProse: Hu Tao leans around a thick bamboo stalk beside the stone path through Qingce’s grove. Only half of her figure has emerged: one index finger touches her lips while her other hand rests against the bamboo. A sly smile and bright flower-shaped pupils invite the viewer to keep her hiding place secret. Her loose dark sweater, red pleated skirt and knee-high socks fit the ordinary morning outing. Clear morning rays fall in broken stripes across the path and sleeves, with green leaves framing the eye-level view. No additional person or lettering.

title: 胡桃 · 和裕茶馆跨界听书
description: 【跨界想象·和裕茶馆】临窗雅座里，胡桃一手托腮，另一手端起青瓷茶盅轻吹热气，饶有兴致地听台上讲《三国演义》。红木桌上留着盖碗托碟与精致茶点；这次把现实小说搬进璃月茶楼的演出，让她也想试着给故事续一首打油诗。
action: 跨界听书时一手托腮，另一手举青瓷茶盅轻吹热气，托碟与茶点留在桌上
lighting: 茶楼雕花木窗滤过的柔和暖木色光影
promptProse: In an imagined crossover at Heyu Tea House, Hu Tao listens to a storyteller recounting Romance of the Three Kingdoms. She props one cheek in her left palm and raises a small celadon tea bowl in her right hand, gently blowing across the steam before a sip. The lid and saucer stay beside the pastries on the redwood table. Her dark sweater and red pleated skirt suit the leisurely visit. Filtered afternoon light draws the lattice pattern across the tabletop while her amused eyes follow the performance beyond the frame. No printed title or lettering.

title: 胡桃 · 蝶引来生烈焰长枪
description: 【胡桃 · 蝶引来生烈焰长枪】炽热火光与阴阳符文交织的古战场上，护摩之杖通体迸发出灼热的赤红烈焰。胡桃压低重心单膝微蹲，双手紧握长枪破空挥斩，无数由纯净火元素凝结而成的火蝶在周身盘旋翻飞——「受命于天，既寿永昌！蝶引来生，火化九幽！」
action: 侧身压低重心单膝微蹲，双手紧握护摩之杖，周身火蝶飞舞烈焰升腾
lighting: 护摩之杖炽烈赤红火光与周身火蝶辉光
camera: full-body shot, dynamic low angle, both hands and full polearm visible
promptProse: Hu Tao settles into a low combat crouch on the cracked altar stones, both hands spaced firmly along the Staff of Homa. The polearm sweeps diagonally across the frame, leaving a thin red fire trail while small flame butterflies circle the shaft. Her director coat tails and red-tipped twintails follow the movement; her flower-shaped eyes stay fixed on the path of the strike. Use a low, wide view that includes her grounded feet, bent knees and the complete weapon. The staff’s red glow supplies the main light against the dim battlefield. No injured opponent or lettering.

title: 时崎狂三 · 月下钟楼
description: 【时崎狂三 · 月下钟楼】巨大的金色时钟表盘在绯红满月下缓缓逆转，狂三立于高耸入云的哥特钟楼之巅。黑色哥特萝莉蓬蓬裙随夜风猎猎作响，左眼的金色时钟刻盘幽光流转，红唇勾起妖异而优雅的弧度——「啊啦啊啦，今夜的月色可真是诱人呢。这位先生，准备好将您的一切……献给刻刻帝了吗？」
action: 立于钟楼顶端，身后金色时钟表盘旋转
camera: full-body shot, dramatic low angle, clock face behind the figure
promptProse: Kurumi stands on the broad crown of a gothic clock tower, her black-and-crimson ruffled dress stirring in the night wind. A vast golden clock face turns behind her beneath a crimson moon. She tilts her head toward the viewer with an assured, enigmatic smile, the clock pattern in her left eye catching the dial’s glow. Cool night ambience separates the tower from the sky while golden light traces her sleeves and long twintails. The low view includes her supported feet and the tower ledge, with no lettering.

title: 时崎狂三 · 黑夜天台
description: 【时崎狂三 · 黑夜天台】夜幕下的都市天台被阴冷的气流席卷，狂三双手优雅地反握着长短两柄复古燧发枪，枪口处缭绕着尚未散尽的紫色灵力微光。她轻歪着头凝视着你，宛如黑夜中漫步的梦魇——「真是个好奇心过剩的人呢。不过……能够走到这一步的你，已经没有逃跑的退路了哦。」
action: 持双燧发枪站在天台边缘
camera: full-body shot, rooftop edge and both weapons visible
promptProse: At the rooftop edge above the midnight city, Kurumi holds one long antique musket and one short flintlock pistol, one in each hand. Both weapons hang low in a theatrical reversed grip rather than pointing at the viewer; faint violet energy curls near their muzzles. Her school uniform’s sailor collar and pleated skirt are clear beneath the cool moonlight. She inclines her head with a questioning half-smile as the distant windows glow behind her. Keep both hands and the visibly different weapon lengths within the wide horizontal frame, without gunfire or lettering.

title: 时崎狂三 · 时间停止的废墟
description: 【时崎狂三 · 时间停止的废墟】破败的断壁残垣与悬停在半空的碎石尘埃被静止的时间彻底冻结。狂三撑着黑色蕾丝遮阳伞漫步在灰白废墟中，宛如游览私家花园般从容，向你投来神秘莫测的笑容——「在属于我的时间领域里，万物皆已停滞。唯有我和你的心跳声，依然在此处回响呢。」
action: 行走在静止时间中的废墟街道
promptProse: Beneath an open black lace parasol, Kurumi takes a measured step through a ruined city street whose debris has stopped in midair. Her black-and-crimson gothic dress moves with her while suspended fragments remain motionless around the path. A small golden clock dial glimmers beyond her shoulder, and she offers the viewer a composed half-smile. Cool night light describes the pale masonry and distant broken archways. Use a wide view with her whole figure, parasol and clear walking space visible. The small clock casts a local golden glow. No lettering.

title: 时崎狂三 · 猫咪咖啡厅
description: 【时崎狂三 · 猫咪咖啡厅】午后阳光洒满温馨的猫咪咖啡厅，脱下灵装换上常服的狂三正怀抱着一只毛茸茸的三花猫，用指尖温柔地替它抓痒。她脸上绽放出毫无防备的纯真笑容——「呼呼，好乖好乖……啊，你刚才一直看着我吗？这种事情可不准说出去哦，会破坏我的形象的。」
promptProse: A sleeping calico cat is nestled against Kurumi’s forearm on the cafe sofa. She scratches gently behind its ear with her free hand, then looks up with an unguarded smile as if surprised to have been noticed. Her loose black cardigan and choker remain visible above the cushion, with no weapons in the quiet room. Afternoon sunlight reaches the cat’s patterned fur and the warm wooden floor. Frame her seated posture and both carefully occupied hands together, keeping the single cat comfortably supported. No lettering.

title: 时崎狂三 · 深夜拉面
description: 【时崎狂三 · 深夜拉面】深夜街角温暖的拉面摊里，狂三坐在吧台高脚凳上，双手捧着热气腾腾的豚骨拉面大碗，眼神里满是少女般的满足与好奇。她转过脸狡黠地向你眨眨眼——「深夜的平民美食果然有一种难以抗拒的魔力呢……怎么，难道精灵就不能喜欢吃拉面吗？」
action: 坐在高脚凳上双手捧住刚端来的拉面碗，转脸眨眼，筷子留在吧台上
promptProse: Kurumi sits on a tall stool at the late-night ramen counter with a newly served bowl cupped in both hands. She turns her face toward the viewer and gives a small conspiratorial wink before beginning to eat. Steam rises between the bowl and her black cardigan; the unused chopsticks rest horizontally on their holder beside the dish. Warm pendant lamps illuminate the wood grain, broth and relaxed expression while the street beyond stays dark. Keep her two hands on the bowl and the chopsticks on the counter, with no lettering.

title: 时崎狂三 · 旧书店午后
description: 【时崎狂三 · 旧书店午后】弥漫着尘封墨香的二手书店角落，午后斜阳穿透彩色玻璃窗洒在沉睡的旧书架上。狂三倚在窗台旁静静翻阅着泛黄的画册，黑发在光影中泛着丝绸般的光泽——「过去的记忆总是这般厚重而脆弱。不过，与您一同度过的这段时间，倒是非常值得放进书页里珍藏呢。」
promptProse: Beside the old bookstore’s stained-glass window, Kurumi leans lightly against the sill and studies a yellowed art album. One hand supports the open volume while the other lifts a single page by its corner. The shelves stand behind her rather than bearing her weight. Slanting afternoon light falls across the illustrations and her loose black cardigan, with dust visible in the beam. Her red-and-gold eyes remain quietly absorbed in the album. The medium view includes the supporting sill and both hands; illustrations need no readable captions.

title: 芙莉莲 · 魔法书研究
description: 【芙莉莲 · 魔法书研究】古老图书馆的高耸书架间浮动着微尘，悬浮的魔法阵在泛黄古籍上方散发出幽蓝的辉光。寿命逾千年的精灵魔法使推了推耳边的白发，专注地研读着失传的民间魔导书——「这是能把温红茶变成甜葡萄汁的魔法。虽然看似没什么用处，但辛美尔当年……一定会觉得很有趣吧。」
action: 在古籍与魔法阵光芒中研读
promptProse: At a reading table between the old library shelves, Frieren studies a folk-magic grimoire opened beneath a small blue magic circle. She tucks a strand of silver-white hair behind her pointed ear while following the diagram with quiet interest. Her white hooded robe and belt retain the chosen mage outfit, and the staff rests beside her chair rather than occupying a reading hand. Warm library light and the blue rune glow meet on the page. Show the chair, supported book and attentive green eyes together, without readable spell instructions.

title: 芙莉莲 · 旷野旅途·苍月草的花海
description: 【芙莉莲 · 旷野旅途】辽阔无垠的北侧荒原上劲风呼啸，白色斗篷在荒凉的大地间猎猎飘扬。芙莉莲手握法杖独自行走在漫长的旅途上，回首望向身后的你，眼眸平静如万古冰川——「精灵的时间很长，人类的一生很短。但既然答应了陪你同行，无论接下来走多久，我都会记着这段旅程。」
action: 手持法杖行走在北侧荒原上，回首望向同行者，斗篷随风扬起
camera: wide shot, low angle, stony path across the open plain
promptProse: Frieren walks along a stony path across the broad northern plain, one hand holding her staff as a steady travelling companion. She looks back over her shoulder without stopping, green eyes calm beneath windblown silver-white twintails. Her pale travel cloak lifts away from practical trousers and boots. Sparse grass, bare earth and long cloud shadows make the route feel exposed and distant. Afternoon sky light keeps the figure clear within the wide landscape. No lettering.

title: 芙莉莲 · 墓地回忆
description: 【芙莉莲 · 墓地回忆】白色野花盛开的静谧墓园里，古旧的石十字架在清晨薄雾中静默伫立。芙莉莲在勇者的墓碑前驻足，指尖轻轻抚过冰冷的石面，绿色眼眸里流露追思。她想起旅途中新找到的魔法，也想起尚未说完的话。
action: 站在勇者墓碑前，以指尖轻触石面，安静追思
promptProse: Frieren stands before Himmel’s weathered stone memorial in the quiet morning cemetery. Her fingertips rest gently against the cool surface while her other hand holds the edge of her travel cloak. Small white wildflowers grow at the base of the monument; she is touching the stone rather than laying down a bouquet. Pale mist softens the distant crosses, leaving her long silver-white twintails, pointed ears and reflective green eyes clear in the near view. The restrained upright posture carries the remembrance, with no readable inscription.

title: 芙莉莲 · 现代咖啡馆
description: 【芙莉莲 · 现代咖啡馆】繁华都市的露天咖啡座上，换上现代便服的芙莉莲正手托香腮，好奇地打量着眼前的拿铁咖啡拉花，神情宛如发现新奇魔法的孩子——「只要用牛奶和奶泡，就能在杯子里画出猫咪的图案吗？现代人类发明出来的东西……意外地很有意思呢。」
lighting: 露天咖啡座的柔和日光
promptProse: In an imagined modern city outing, Frieren sits at an outdoor cafe table with one cheek resting in her palm. A latte topped with a small cat-shaped foam pattern stays on its saucer in front of her; she studies it as intently as a newly discovered spell. Her soft casual dress and cardigan suit the relaxed terrace, and a breeze moves the ends of her silver-white twintails. Daylight reflected from the street illuminates her curious green eyes. Keep her free hand resting on the table and the cup on the saucer, without lettering.

title: 芙莉莲 · 超市试吃
description: 【芙莉莲 · 超市试吃】大型超市热闹的熟食试吃区前，芙莉莲神情极其严肃地用牙签扎起一小块煎香肠放入口中，细细咀嚼后认真地点了点头——「味道很浓郁。听说只要假装挑选商品就能免费一直吃……这种被称作‘试吃’的习俗，简直比寻找魔法书还要美妙。」
promptProse: At a supermarket tasting counter during a modern-day fantasy outing, Frieren lifts one small piece of cooked sausage on a toothpick and considers the flavour with grave concentration. Her other hand rests near the sample tray, leaving the single bite and delicate grip easy to read. A soft casual dress and cardigan distinguish this ordinary visit from a journey in mage robes. Even aisle lighting catches her green eyes and silver-white twintails as she gives a tiny approving nod. Show one shopper and the counter without readable labels or promotional signs.

title: 芙莉莲 · 公园长椅
description: 【芙莉莲 · 公园长椅】午后暖阳透过绿荫洒在公园的木质长椅上，芙莉莲将法杖抱在怀里，脑袋一点一点地打着瞌睡，白发在微风中轻轻摇曳。她半睁开睡眼迷蒙的眼睛——「唔……别摇我。早上起太早了，菲伦又不在……就让我再睡一小会儿嘛。」
promptProse: Frieren dozes on a wooden park bench beneath a canopy of green leaves, her staff held loosely across her lap in both arms. Her head dips slightly, then her green eyes open halfway before sleep draws them closed again. The soft dress and cardigan gather naturally over the seated figure, with long silver-white twintails resting along the back of the bench. Dappled afternoon light moves over the staff and sleeves. Keep the quiet summer greenery and supported resting posture clear, with no lettering.
